question.nlq: Could you tell me the average transaction amount of all accounts for customers who have more than one card?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the overall average transaction amount across all accounts of customers who have more than one card, i.e., one combined value.
meanings.gt_sql: SELECT AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Customers_Cards GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

meanings.hidden_knowledge: I mean the average transaction amount for each account of customers who have more than one card, listed per account.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH multi_card_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM Customers_Cards
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS average_transaction_amount
FROM Accounts a
JOIN multi_card_customers mcc ON a.customer_id = mcc.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id;
